title: Prediction markets on PKU
source_note: Candidate prediction markets anchored to atlas data points. Each carries an objective resolution source and the atlas tab whose data motivates it. Status tracks whether a market has been posted on an exchange.

records.question: Will the FDA clear any at-home phenylalanine test before Dec 31, 2028?
records.resolves_on: FDA device clearance database (510(k), De Novo, or PMA) listing a phenylalanine test indicated for home or lay use
records.anchor_fact: No cleared home phe monitor exists. Contenders are pre-market: PheCheck holds FDA Breakthrough Designation and was in validation in 2026, Egoo Phe is CE-marked and running a US trial.

records.question: Will Aptatek file an FDA submission for PheCheck before Dec 31, 2027?
records.resolves_on: Company announcement or FDA submission record
records.anchor_fact: PheCheck is an aptamer-based in-home phe monitor with FDA Breakthrough Designation, still a research prototype as of 2026.

records.question: Will the Egoo Phe US trial report results before July 1, 2027?
records.resolves_on: ClinicalTrials.gov results posting or company announcement
records.anchor_fact: Egoo Phe is CE-marked and available in the EU only, with a US trial underway.

records.question: Will a US patient be able to get a blood phe result in under 24 hours through any commercial pathway by Dec 31, 2028?
records.resolves_on: Publicly advertised commercial service or cleared device offering sub-24-hour phe turnaround to US patients
records.anchor_fact: Monitoring depends on dried blood spot cards mailed to a lab, with results returning roughly 5 to 14 days later.

records.question: Will the repinatrabit (JNT-517) Phase 3 trial report a positive primary endpoint before Dec 31, 2027?
records.resolves_on: Otsuka announcement or ClinicalTrials.gov results for NCT06971731
records.anchor_fact: Otsuka acquired JNT-517 from Jnana for up to about 1.1 billion dollars and began a global registrational Phase 3 in Oct 2025. It is an oral, diet-independent candidate.

records.question: Will repinatrabit receive FDA approval before Dec 31, 2029?
records.anchor_fact: Phase 3 began Oct 2025. First-in-class oral small molecule that would not require dietary restriction.

records.question: Will any PKU gene therapy dose a patient in a new US trial before Dec 31, 2027?
records.resolves_on: ClinicalTrials.gov status change to recruiting or active with a US site, for a PKU gene therapy not previously dosing
records.anchor_fact: The gene therapy race stalled. BMN 307 has been on clinical hold since 2021, Homology withdrew HMI-102 and HMI-103, leaving Sanofi SAR444836 and NGGT002.

records.question: Will Moderna's mRNA-3283 enter Phase 2 before Dec 31, 2027?
records.anchor_fact: mRNA-3283 is in early clinical development within Moderna's rare disease portfolio.

records.question: Will Sephience (sepiapterin) report over 100 million dollars in net sales for a full calendar year before 2029?
records.resolves_on: PTC Therapeutics annual report or SEC filing
records.anchor_fact: Sephience was FDA-approved July 2025 and broke BioMarin's duopoly. Estimated annual cost about 492 thousand dollars.

records.question: Will any Palynziq (pegvaliase) biosimilar application be filed before Dec 31, 2030?
records.resolves_on: FDA filing acceptance or litigation record
records.anchor_fact: Kuvan was commoditized by generics after the 2017 patent settlement, but the higher-value biologic Palynziq shows no reported generic or patent litigation.

records.question: Will the Medical Foods and Formulas Access Act pass either chamber of Congress before Jan 3, 2027?
records.resolves_on: Congress.gov roll call showing House or Senate passage of H.R. 5684 or a successor bill
records.anchor_fact: The Medical Nutrition Equity Act has been introduced at least five times since 2017 and has never been enacted. It carries no CBO score and dies in committee each Congress.

records.question: Will any US state enact a new full medical-food mandate covering both formula and low-protein foods before Dec 31, 2027?
records.anchor_fact: 16 states plus DC have no mandate and 19 more are partial, most commonly covering formula while excluding low-protein modified foods.

records.question: Will Ohio, Michigan, Georgia, or North Carolina enact any PKU medical-food coverage mandate before Dec 31, 2028?
records.resolves_on: Enacted statute in any of the four named states
records.anchor_fact: These are the four largest-population states with no mandate at all. Ohio Medicaid is formula-only, so low-protein foods are essentially out of pocket.

records.question: Will a putative class action over PKU medical-food or formula coverage denial be filed in North Carolina before Dec 31, 2027?
records.resolves_on: A putative class complaint alleging denial of PKU formula or medical-food coverage, filed in a North Carolina state or federal court, verifiable on PACER or NC court records
records.anchor_fact: North Carolina has no coverage mandate and a large patient population, with families relying on case-by-case Medicaid. No PKU coverage class action has been identified in any state to date; the documented pattern is individual ERISA appeals, and ERISA preemption of self-funded plans is the structural barrier to a class vehicle.

records.question: Will a putative class action over PKU medical-food or formula coverage denial be filed in any US state before Dec 31, 2027?
records.resolves_on: A putative class complaint on PKU formula or medical-food denial filed in any US state or federal court, verifiable on PACER
records.anchor_fact: The broader version of the North Carolina market. No such class action has been identified to date.

records.question: Will any state attorney general or insurance commissioner open an enforcement action over medical-food coverage denials before Dec 31, 2028?
records.resolves_on: Published AG or insurance-department enforcement action or consent order
records.anchor_fact: Coverage-denial appeals are high-volume but administrative rather than courtroom, and no regulator enforcement sweep has been identified.

records.question: Will another PKU formula or low-protein food company be acquired by a major food or pharma group before Dec 31, 2027?
records.resolves_on: Announced acquisition of a company with a PKU formula or low-protein food line
records.anchor_fact: The segment is a conglomerate duopoly. Nestle Health Science acquired Dr. Schar's inborn-errors-of-metabolism business in 2021, and Ajinomoto holds Cambrooke.

records.question: Will a GMP-based protein substitute gain national reimbursement in a new major market before Dec 31, 2028?
records.resolves_on: National formulary or reimbursement listing in a G20 market
records.anchor_fact: GMP products are displacing traditional amino-acid formulas, with the category growing at roughly 9 to 10 percent annually.

records.question: Will any AI phe-estimator app publish accuracy scored against a public benchmark before July 1, 2027?
records.resolves_on: Published result on a public, reproducible phe-estimation benchmark
records.anchor_fact: AI estimators are arriving fast, including Cycle Vita PKU, with no shared standard for judging accuracy. PKU Commons operates a public benchmark.
